# A box's alignment and a label's background, drawn by fyne.
#
# Fyne's box stretched every child across it whatever `alignItems` said, and
# its theme colours no label's box, so a badge drew as plain text. `plain`
# and `badged` write the same text, the second as a badge; `left` and
# `centred` the same column, the second centred; `flips` a badge whose colour
# is state, before and after it changes. testdata/fyne_box_align_backdrop.txtar
# shows the calls, and pkg/go/fynelayout and pkg/go/fynetheme measure them.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=fyne app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'
exists app.sngl.snapshots/plain.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/plain.png app.sngl.snapshots/badged.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/left.png app.sngl.snapshots/centred.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/before.png app.sngl.snapshots/after.png

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output { go { fyne } }

component plain ui.node {
    ui.hbox(style={gap=8px, alignItems=start}) {
        ui.text(value="Grass")
    }
}

component badged ui.node {
    ui.hbox(style={gap=8px, alignItems=start}) {
        ui.badge(value="Grass", style={background=#339933, color=#ffffff})
    }
}

component left ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text(value="Centre me")
    }
}

component centred ui.node {
    ui.vbox(style={alignItems=center}) {
        ui.text(value="Centre me")
    }
}

component flips ui.node {
    var hot = false
    ui.hbox(style={gap=8px, alignItems=start}) {
        ui.badge(value="Shifting", style={background=hot ? #cc3333 : #339933, color=#ffffff})
        ui.button #flip(text="flip", @click { hot = true })
    }
}

func testPlain(t test.Test, c plain) {
    t.snapshot("plain")
}

func testBadged(t test.Test, c badged) {
    t.snapshot("badged")
}

func testLeft(t test.Test, c left) {
    t.snapshot("left")
}

func testCentred(t test.Test, c centred) {
    t.snapshot("centred")
}

func testFlips(t test.Test, c flips) {
    t.snapshot("before")
    c.flip.click()
    t.snapshot("after")
}

ui.window {
    badged
}
